name: smoke150
description: Composite evaluation set: smoke100 (historical regression) + smoke50_parent_expansion_v1 (parent-expansion-sensitive extension)
notes: smoke50_parent_expansion_v1 was originally built as Phase 12G holdout50 and promoted to formal regression extension after passing Phase 12G/12H validation.
After merging into main, smoke50_parent_expansion_v1 should be treated as a regression set, not as an unseen holdout.
Future smoke200 can be built by adding another smoke50 extension.
